map.递推 F(n) = F(n−1) + F(n−2)，初值 F(1)=F(2)=1: Recurrence F(n) = F(n−1) + F(n−2), initial values F(1)=F(2)=1; ratio of consecutive terms F(n+1)/F(n) → golden ratio φ ≈ 1.618
map.递推式 F(1)=F(2)=1、F(n)=F(n−1)+F(n−2)；本页按 1: Recurrence F(1)=F(2)=1, F(n)=F(n−1)+F(n−2); this page uses 1-based indexing, is BigInt-exact throughout, and computes F(n) directly in single-term mode with fast doubling (O(log n)).
map.本页采用 1 基定义：F(1)=F(2)=1，F(n)=F(n−1)+F(n−2: This page uses the 1-based definition: F(1)=F(2)=1, F(n)=F(n−1)+F(n−2). "Sequence mode" generates F(1)…F(n) term by term and plots log-scale bars by digit count; "single-term mode" uses fast doubling to compute F(n) directly with only O(log n) multiplications. Both modes use BigInt, so results are exact digit by digit and not bound by the 2^53 precision limit of Number; n is capped at 100000, above which it prompts "N too large; keep it <= 100000".

map.相邻项比趋近黄金比 φ=(1+√5)/2≈1.618。按页面精度（保留 10 位: The ratio of adjacent terms approaches the golden ratio φ=(1+√5)/2≈1.618. Run at the page's precision (10 decimals): F(20)/F(19)=1.6180339632, F(21)/F(20)=1.6180339985. The digit count grows approximately as n·log₁₀φ≈0.209n, so F(100) has 21 digits and F(200) has 42 - the digit count grows linearly while the value itself grows exponentially.
map.把 F(0)=0 当首项：本页从 1 开始编号，n=0 是非法输入而不是返回 0: Treating F(0)=0 as the first term: this page numbers from 1, so n=0 is an invalid input rather than a 0 result; confirm the indexing origin when citing external sources. Computing large n with ordinary Number: integers lose accuracy beyond 2^53, so BigInt is required (as used here). Reading "digits of the last term" as the value: the digit count only describes length; F(10)=55 has 2 digits, which says nothing more about 55.
